title: Set-writer templates are wasm-safe: no filesystem, no std::env, no time, deterministic output
description: Audit apricity-daw for anything that will not build or behave under wasm32-wasip1 (file reads for templates, current time, env lookups, random ids). Templates must be include_bytes!, ids derived from content. Verification: the wasm build of apricity-web succeeds and the parity script passes.
